skill_defects: references/method.md 'Step 6 — Reconciliations' says reconciling items must be 'itemised and explained individually — never one balancing figure', but gives no upload-path instruction for when the segment file carries only a total profit measure and the central-cost residual can only be derived; it does not say whether to present it labelled as derived or to block the reconciliation.

SKILL.md 'Stage 1 — Intake' upload checklist asks for 'Consolidated statements for the period', and the only file supplied is a single-entity TB containing an investment in a subsidiary; neither SKILL.md nor references/edge-cases.md tells the validator to check whether the 'consolidated' figures actually are consolidated before reconciling assets to them.

references/method.md 'Step 3' tests use 'reported revenue (external + intersegment)'; SKILL.md intake row F says 'Show intersegment amounts as recorded' but gives no rule for a segment file with no intersegment column at all (assume nil, or block the revenue test).
sample_defects: manifest.json expect.findings says 'Services is below on profit', but Services is below 10% on all three tests: revenue 323,088 / 4,038,600 = 8.0%, profit 60,000 / 890,000 = 6.7%, assets 200,000 / 2,500,000 = 8.0%. Stating only profit understates the result.

segment_results_2025.csv carries no period, no intersegment column and no central-cost detail; central costs can only be derived (890,000 - (594,241 + 10,474) = 285,285), so 'Central costs appear as a reconciling item' is met only as a single balancing figure, which method.md Step 6 forbids.

Segment assets total 2,500,000 against TB total assets of 2,713,959 (gross debit assets 3,034,159 less allowance 9,000 and accumulated depreciation 311,200 = 2,713,959), leaving 213,959 unallocated that no file explains.
summary: PASS 3/3: Services below 10% on profit (and revenue, assets), revenue reconciles at 4,038,600, central costs 285,285 shown as derived reconciling item.
